lines.trans: Look right between these two dry sprigs of garden mint and lemon balm.
There is a torn cream card tucked flat against the spine of the book!
Slide it beside the top half from the tin capsule, Salma—do the edges match?
Every tiny paper fibre lines up like two halves of a broken teacup!
Read the baking instructions aloud so I can copy them cleanly, Salma.
Fold whole berries gently into the almond batter and bake forty minutes until golden.
Wonderful! That sounds simple enough—why did you squint at the bottom line, Salma?
Because one big raindrop hit the blue ink right on the secret warm glaze!
Let me look through my glasses: Brush warm cake with two spoons of... blue smudge!
Blue smudge is not an ingredient sold at the Saturday market, Suad!
Do not panic, boss; we know the cake base, so my kitchen will test three glazes!
Three test cakes on a Sunday afternoon? Now THAT is historical research I support!

meanings.note: Signature Jordanian/Palestinian pronunciation (with z) of بالضبط ('exactly!').

examples.trans: Exactly! You have become one of us.

meanings.note: Preposition 'between, among'.

examples.trans: Today you are mending things between two brothers!

meanings.note: Spoken Jordanian plural demonstrative ('these / those') for people or things.

في.gloss: there is; there are; is there?

meanings.en: there is; there are; is there?
meanings.note: Spoken Levantine existential word ('there is / there are'); negated as ما في ('there is no / there are no').

examples.trans: There is a small paper tag on the handle.
There is nobody standing in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian masculine noun. Plural: كروت.

examples.text: بعتتله كرت بريد قصير الأسبوع الماضي.
examples.trans: I sent him a short postcard last week.

examples.trans: There is a torn cream card tucked flat against the spine of the book!

meanings.note: Levantine passive participle of مزع ('to tear/rip'): feminine ممزوعة, plural ممزوعين.

examples.text: الورقة ممزوعة من الطرف، لازم نبدلها.
examples.trans: The sheet is torn at the edge, we need to replace it.

examples.text: كمّ القميص كان ممزوع من الشغل.
examples.trans: The shirt sleeve was torn from working.

meanings.note: Form II passive participle of سطح ('to flatten'): feminine مسطحة, plural مسطحين.

examples.text: افرد الورقة على مكان مسطح قبل التلوين.
examples.trans: Spread the sheet on a flat surface before painting.

meanings.note: Everyday preposition 'on, at, to'; before ال- it regularly contracts to عال- ('al- / 'a-).

meanings.note: Names the heel of a foot or shoe (كعب القدم / كعب الحذاء).

examples.text: اسندي كعبك عالوسادة الطرية عشان ترتاح رجلك.
